playoff.entries: 9th in TOPLYGA vs 2nd in I Lyga
playoff.note: Two-legged tie for the last place in next season's TOPLYGA.

playoff.entries: 2nd in I Lyga vs 9th in TOPLYGA
playoff.note: Same tie from the other side; 3rd-last also plays a play-off against the 3rd-placed II Lyga club for a I Lyga place.

boundaries.note: I Lyga champion goes up, TOPLYGA 10th goes down directly; I Lyga 2nd meets TOPLYGA 9th over two legs for the second place, so only one of the two clubs in that tie plays in the top flight next season.

conflicts.note: The I Lyga infobox still says 16 clubs, but the approved 2026 participant list on the same page has 18 (including six B teams). Used 18 for the season.
Correct: the A Lyga was renamed TOPLYGA from 2026. Only the capitalisation differs.

notes: Calendar-year season (Feb-Nov 2026), so '2026' is the dataset label rather than the 2026-27 career year. TOPLYGA: 10 clubs, four rounds (36 matches) - clubs played 32 in 2026 because Riteriai withdrew and their results were annulled, and were relegated. The 9th-place play-off against the I Lyga runner-up (Minija) was still being played on 20 Nov 2026. II Lyga (level 3, two divisions, 16 + 12) is below our list: I Lyga's bottom two go down and 3rd-last plays a play-off, but LTU2 is closed_down in our data because we do not carry level 3. Reserve (B) teams are numerous in I Lyga and cannot be promoted above it.
